name: Eicher Motors Ltd
title: Eicher Motors Ltd - 505200 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Eicher Q4 FY26 PAT of INR1,520m on 6,080m revenue at record volumes, but Q1 faces a 3–3.5% material-cost headwind with only ~50% recovered via a 1.75% price hike; Royal Enfield capacity to rise 1.4m→1.6m/yr via INR958m Cheyyar brownfield.

triggers.label: Material cost headwind 3–3.5%
triggers.quote: it is 3 to 3.5 percentage on the material level is expected

guidance.quote: it is expected to be in the range of 3% to 3.5%

red_flags.label: Q1 FY27 margin pressure, only half recovered

evasions.quote: we are confident we can mitigate it to a maximum extent

summary.headline: Eicher Motors Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue INR8,280.6 mn? No: Q4 consolidated revenue INR6,080 crore? Transcript-stated EML Q4 revenue INR6,080, PAT INR1,520.

financial_highlights.metric: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue (EML, as stated by Govind)
Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue (VECV, as stated by Srinivas)

segments.name: Royal Enfield (motorcycles)
segments.commentary: FY26 domestic motorcycle sales rose 23% to 1.1 million units; exports grew 20% to 120,634 units. Record FY26 total of 1.227 million motorcycles, with Brazil up 71% and now the largest international market. Apparel grew 21%, Genuine Motorcycle Accessories rose 32%, and spare parts grew 18%.

segments.name: VECV (commercial vehicles)
segments.commentary: FY26 volumes of 103,404 units, up 15%. Heavy-duty truck volumes were 25,155 with market share up to 9.1% from 8.4%... (stated as 14.1% growth with share improving to 9.1%); LMD trucks 46,195; buses 18,651; exports up 33.9% to 6,933 units; spare parts revenue up 13.9% to INR3,045.5 crore.

segments.name: Volvo Financial Services JV (proposed)
segments.commentary: Proposed 50:50 JV with Volvo Group for financing, leasing and other services, with EML investing up to INR750 crore for a 50% stake; the target company has assets under management of INR1,806 crore and has been operating for 10 years.

guidance_outlook: Management does not normally give numeric forward guidance; said the company is geared for a growth-led FY27.
Domestic motorcycle inquiry levels up 23% vs the previous period; booking rates at 7-8 days in May; bookings for 2025 vehicles described as strong.
Production capacity to be raised from 1.4 million to 1.6 million motorcycles per year by June-July 2026 via the 500 per day module, ahead of festive season.
Cheyyar brownfield expansion (INR958 crore capex) to add 2 million units of annual capacity by Q2 FY28.
Q1 FY27 material-cost headwind of 3% to 3.5% of material costs; 50% expected to be recovered via pricing and the rest via austerity and engineering savings, with projects kicking in by July-August.
Greenfield facility in Andhra Pradesh on 261 acres signed with the state government; typical 24-30 month window to become fully operational.
Medium-term: management expects the VECV trajectory to be upward; India's long-term drivers cited as infrastructure, logistics, e-commerce and cleaner mobility.
capex_capacity: Cheyyar (Tamil Nadu) brownfield expansion approved in February at INR958 crore, adding capacity from 1.6 million to 2 million units per year, targeted by Q2 FY28.
Current capacity of 1.4 million motorcycles per year, with a 500 per day module adding capacity to 1.6 million by June-July 2026.
Andhra Pradesh greenfield: 261 acres signed; MoU with state government; capacity to be planned beyond 2 million units.
JV investment capacity: up to INR750 crore for 50% of Volvo financing JV; target company net worth INR500 crore; management said it is adequately capitalised for the medium term.
Cheyyar land acquisition of 65 acres already in hand.
demand_pricing: Industry 250-750cc: management said FY26 domestic category sold 1.11 million motorcycles, up 23%; Q4 sales of 1.04 million, up 57% (as stated).
Inquiry levels up 23% vs previous period; no structural correction in demand per management.
Q4 price increase of 1.75% in April; Q4 margin pressure of 90 bps from costs, with 70 bps blended price increase taken in January and 20 bps offset by cost reduction and mix.
Premiumisation continuing; first-time buyers rising, with 30% of consumers under 25 years of age; GST reduction cited as a helper.
Europe continued to degrow; US tariff issues described as settled; US about 3% of total business.
VECV: entire FY26 broad-based growth; EV Pro X trucks delivered 2,452, incl. 726 EVs. Pro X named Debutant of the Year at Apollo CV Awards.
Supply disruptions in April-May from elections, manpower availability, LPG shortages and power issues described as temporary, lasting 1-2 weeks, with deliveries restarting.
Mid-size bike CAGR and inquiry momentum cited; no quantified category growth number.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY27 retail outlook for the mid-size motorcycle category, and what are the expansion plans given thin dealer inventories?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said FY26 industry sales were 1.11 million, up 23%, with no structural demand correction; bookings are 7-8 days, temporary supply issues are expected to clear in a week to 10 days, and capacity is going to 1.6 million units by June-July with the Cheyyar expansion by Q2 FY28.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the 3-3.5% material cost headwind is being passed on through pricing, and how much is being offset?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said about 50% of the 3-3.5% material cost headwind is recovered through the 1.75% April price increase, with the remaining 50% addressed through austerity measures and engineering savings; the Q4 margin hit was 90 bps, of which 70 bps was recovered in January pricing.

qa_highlights.question: Will the Volvo financing JV see profit benefits and will it be a capital-hungry business?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the JV will run independently with its own risk profile and that EML will invest up to INR750 crore for 50%; the target has INR1,806 crore AUM; management expects to grow AUM to INR9,000-10,000 crore over 5 years with no hurry to scale.

qa_highlights.question: What are the product pipeline and timelines, including the Bullet 650 and any plans below 350cc?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the project timelines shown at EICMA are on track; the Bullet 650 dispatch has started and the S6 was shown; the company focuses on 250-750cc, with platforms at 350cc, 450cc and 650cc.

qa_highlights.question: What is the timeline for the Andhra Pradesh greenfield plant and its capacity ramp?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the land MoU was signed this week, with the 261-acre parcel to be acquired; a plant is typically 24-30 months from land to full operation; no greenfield capacity timeline was given.

qa_highlights.question: What is the MHCV outlook and how are fuel price hikes and labour shortages affecting demand?
qa_highlights.answer: VECV management said it took about 2% price increases from 1 April, with pass-through lagging due to time-bound transporter contracts; labour and LPG disruptions lasted 2-3 weeks and supply is improving.

risks_watch: Input cost inflation: 3-3.5% material cost headwind in Q1 FY27 from the geopolitical situation, with only 50% expected to be recovered through pricing; watch Q1 gross margin.
Supply chain: elections, LPG availability, power issues and migrant labour movement disrupted production and deliveries in April-May; management expects normalisation within 1-2 weeks.
Fuel price hikes may hit transporter economics and the CV secondary market; VECV's pass-through is lagged by time-bound contracts.
Europe continued to degrow due to pre-registration effects of OBD2B, delaying billing; US tariff matters described as settled but still a drag.
Volvo financing JV: capital commitment of up to INR750 crore and dependence on a new business with a longer-term payoff.
Greenfield Andhra Pradesh plant: no timeline given beyond the 24-30 month window; the Cheyyar 2 million capacity target is set for Q2 FY28.
Replacement cycle yet to kick in; the digital platform's traction is slightly better but from a low base.
Q1 FY27 volume tracking to 1.6 million capacity by June-July; watch whether the capacity ramp meets festive-season demand.

adds.what: Motorcycle capacity raised from 1.4 million to 1.6 million units/yr via 500-per-day module
Cheyyar brownfield expansion adding 2 million units/yr (1.6m to 2m)
Andhra Pradesh greenfield facility on 261 acres (capacity beyond 2 million units)

growth.why: Management gives no numeric forward guidance but says the company is geared for a growth-led FY27, backed by a 1.4m to 1.6m motorcycle capacity step-up by June-July 2026, Cheyyar expansion (INR958 crore, to 2m units by Q2 FY28), inquiry up 23% and 7-8 day booking rates.
